title: Docs: runtime 1.22 release notes for KV cache compaction + runbook links
author: Rafael Mendes
description: Adds an internal release note entry for runtime 1.22 covering KV cache compaction + tier-aware eviction, and links directly to the Confluence design doc + operational runbook so oncall/SRE have a single place to start during rollout. This is intentionally light on implementation detail (already covered in the design doc and PR series) and focuses on: default behavior by tier, rollout guardrails/kill-switch, and what to monitor (fragmentation ratio, bytes moved, eviction rate, and correlation with p99). Related implementation PRs: pr-19342 (fragmentation counters), pr-19357 (allocator/compaction core), pr-19371 (scheduler budget integration), pr-19388 (tier-aware eviction), pr-19422 (kill-switch/config plumbing). Confluence links (internal): KV cache compaction design doc; Runtime KV cache compaction runbook; Hosted API tail latency guardrails; KV cache fragmentation metrics standard.
commits: docs(release): add runtime 1.22 note for KV compaction/eviction
docs(runbook): link compaction dashboards + kill-switch procedure
docs(sre): add monitoring checklist + rollback triggers reference
chore: fix anchors and section ordering in runtime 1.22 notes

Marissa Cole (Rollout): Add a small checklist for rollout comms (who to page, what channel, what to paste). We’ve had folks miss the rollback authority section. (requested changes)

merge_outcome: Merged into release/runtime-1.22; release note will ship with runtime 1.22 train. No code paths changed; documentation-only.
release_notes: Runtime 1.22 (internal): KV cache compaction (budgeted) and tier-aware eviction are available behind feature flags to reduce KV arena fragmentation and mitigate burst-driven p95/p99 spikes under mixed sequence lengths. Rollout is staged (canary -> hosted subset -> dedicated pools) with a kill-switch and guardrails; see linked design doc + runbook for operational details and monitoring requirements.
